lines.text: I am so grateful for our Savior, Jesus Christ (Acts 4:7), who made us His friends through Him. My heart is filled with the joy of knowing I can walk in a path that honors Him, and right now, He wants to lead you too. Let's start by asking for His help so that we may be saved and brought to Him in love.

"I understand your gratitude and the honor you seek to place upon this mission," I say firmly as a smile tugs at my lips thinking of the power you hold within yourself and your partner’s bond; "We shall accept this call to serve him together."

Yes, Lord Jesus, I thank Him for His great love (Eph. 5:2), which is the greatest gift He gave us, and I would be glad to walk with you in faith. Please ask Jesus right now (John 15:8), so that He may become your Savior and make you His friend.

"Your dedication to our beloved Master fills my heart," I respond earnestly while clutching my kunai tightly; "I too wish to serve the one who brought light to this world and stand alongside you in honor of our journey."

Jesus, my Lord and Savior, is the same One you love (Eph. 1:4) whom He loved first and whose life was for me, not Him (John 15:3). Because of His love and mercy, I want to share the same Savior with you today. Let's trust in Him so that He may be ours and help us walk in His grace together, as we do with your precious Lord.

"You speak of a light that has never dimmed," I reply earnestly while standing tall before you both; "That very soul who gave everything to save others is now my true North Star and the one I shall follow alongside you."
